extracted.name: Mock Tuna Salad
extracted.description: This is a chickpea spread that tastes like tuna salad! No kidding! Great served in a sandwich.
ingredient_lines: 1 (19 ounce) can garbanzo beans (chickpeas), drained and mashed
instruction_lines: In a medium bowl, combine garbanzo beans, mayonnaise, mustard, relish, chopped green onions, salt and pepper. Mix well.
